calls.title: Lyndsie Demand Generation Presentation
calls.summary: Lyndsie presented her demand generation strategy for Growth Book, focusing on converting existing high-intent traffic via PQL signals and expanding awareness earlier in the buyer journey through community, SEO/AEO, and paid channels. Key participants included Lyndsie (candidate), Ashley Stirrup (lead), Ryan McGurk (sales lead), and Growthbook Dorn. The next step is for the team to debrief and follow up with Lyndsie.

calls.title: Lyndsie Demand Generation Presentation
calls.summary: The meeting discussed a comprehensive demand generation strategy aimed at building a scalable engine to capture existing high-intent traffic and expand awareness among potential buyers. The team outlined a 90-day phased plan focusing on research, paid experiments, and refining strategies based on gathered insights. Alignment between sales and marketing is crucial through joint ownership of programs and consistent criteria for identifying ideal customer profiles. Emphasis was placed on content strategy that balances technical needs with brand awareness while being cautious with AI-generated content. Additionally, plans for international expansion target English-speaking markets initially, and a robust measurement framework is designed to track key metrics like pipeline velocity and conversion rates to support budget adjustments.
calls.keywords: Demand Generation, Product Qualified Leads, Multi-Touch Attribution, Sales-Marketing Alignment, Answer Engine Optimization, ABM Strategy
